notes: 1.6T OSFP DSP Active Optical Cable (integrated cable, not a pluggable transceiver module with separate optical connector). Forward error correction (FEC) is required to be implemented by the host. Case operating temperature 0°C to 70°C without air flow. Optical transmission distance 0.5–100 m (Recommended Operating Conditions); standard cable lengths 1, 5, 10, 30, 50, 100 meters (XXX in part number). Power dissipation 26 W max per cable end. Each channel data rate 106.25@PAM4 GBd. Housing variants IHS (AOP13PI8-XXX-3) and RHS (AOP13PI8-XXX-3R). Single 3.3 V power supply (3.135–3.465 V operating). Electrical interface: 60-pin edge connector per OSFP MSA.
